title.value: Prepare federal and state tax returns from a folder

introduction.value: A Redditor pointed Claude at their tax folder and asked it to do their taxes; they say returns for 2024 and 2025 came back in 15 minutes and matched TurboTax, but needed mailing.

method.value: The Redditor sqlgenius pointed Claude at the tax folder on their computer and typed a short "do my taxes" request. Claude read the tax forms, asked a few follow-up questions, and carried over the Redditor's prior trading losses. To check it, the Redditor ran the same information through TurboTax.

outcome.value: The Redditor says Claude produced federal and state returns for 2024 and 2025 in 15 minutes, and that TurboTax gave the same results. This is a self-reported Reddit claim. Experts quoted say it fits simple returns better than complex ones.

notes.value: Claude can't e-file, so the returns must be mailed. The taxpayer is liable for any errors, and AI may use stale tax rules.

source_text.body:
Prepare federal and state tax returns from a folder
A Redditor pointed Claude at their tax folder and asked it to do their taxes; they say returns for 2024 and 2025 came back in 15 minutes and matched TurboTax, but needed mailing.
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
The Redditor sqlgenius pointed Claude at the tax folder on their computer and typed a short "do my taxes" request. Claude read the tax forms, asked a few follow-up questions, and carried over the Redditor's prior trading losses. To check it, the Redditor ran the same information through TurboTax.
How it went
The Redditor says Claude produced federal and state returns for 2024 and 2025 in 15 minutes, and that TurboTax gave the same results. This is a self-reported Reddit claim. Experts quoted say it fits simple returns better than complex ones.
Worth knowing
Claude can't e-file, so the returns must be mailed. The taxpayer is liable for any errors, and AI may use stale tax rules.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Look through the folder [path to your tax folder] containing my [tax year] tax documents. Work out my federal and [state] returns, list every figure you pulled and which file it came from, and flag anything missing or ambiguous. Finish with a draft summary I can check against my tax software; do not file or send anything, and ask me before changing any files.
Original source: https://www.inc.com/melissa-angell/claude-did-this-redditors-taxes-they-claim-intuit-is-cooked/91328075
source_text.scope: Captured case text; external linked articles and HTML excluded.

introduction.en: A media account relays a Reddit user’s experience producing tax drafts with Claude.
introduction.zh: 一篇媒体文章转述 Reddit 用户用 Claude 生成税表草稿的经历。

method.en: A media account relays Reddit user sqlgenius pointing Claude at a local tax folder, answering follow-up questions and carrying forward prior trading losses.
method.zh: 媒体转述Reddit用户sqlgenius把本地税务文件夹交给Claude，回答后续问题并结转以前的交易损失。

method.en: The person independently entered the same information in TurboTax for comparison. The actual source label is Claude; the recommended template names Claude Code.
method.zh: 本人将同样资料另行输入TurboTax作比较；源站实际标签为Claude，推荐模板则写Claude Code。

outcome.en: The user claims federal and state returns for both 2024 and 2025 were ready in fifteen minutes and matched TurboTax. No independent correctness audit is supplied.
outcome.zh: 用户声称十五分钟完成2024及2025两年的联邦、州税表，结果与TurboTax一致，但没有独立准确性审计。

notes.en: The source says these drafts required mailing rather than e-filing, quotes experts favoring simpler returns and warns about stale rules and taxpayer responsibility. These are the report’s cautions, not legal advice here.
notes.zh: 源站称草稿需邮寄、不能电子申报，并转述专家认为更适合简单税表，提醒旧税规及纳税人责任；这些是原报道提醒，不是本档案法律建议。
